{{Quote|Biggs's death shook Huff. He decided he wanted more heirs. His second wife decided she wasn't interested in having any more than the one she'd already borne. She left, and Huff married me.|Lanal Darklighter|<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Human''' was the second [[Marriage/Legends|marriage|wife]] of [[Huff Darklighter]] and the mother of their daughter, [[Dera Darklighter]].<ref name="BW" />

After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Huff decided he wanted more heirs. His second wife was not interested in having any more children, which resulted in her leaving and Huff marrying [[Lanal Darklighter]].<ref name="BW" />
